LanguageData.DMS_Make_Ape.label: Gestate Ape Automatroid
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Ape.description: Gestate an Ape Automatroid, a technology demonstrator that handles both medium and heavy mech weapons with ease.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Arquebusier.label: Gestate Arquebusier
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Arquebusier.description: Gestate an arquebusier mechanoid, the standard version of mechanized soldiers with the ability to operate most common weapons.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_BattleFrame.label: Gestate a Battle Frame Automatroid
LanguageData.DMS_Make_BattleFrame.description: Gestate a battle frame, a multipurpose framed robot with a high combat load capacity and fast reaction speed.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_EscortLifter.label: Gestate an Escort Lifter Automatroid
LanguageData.DMS_Make_EscortLifter.description: Gestate an escort lifter, the logistics transport conversion of the battle frame.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_FieldCommand.label: Gestate a Field Command Automatroid
LanguageData.DMS_Make_FieldCommand.description: Gestate a field command unit, a mechanitor relay-command variant fitted with an omnidirectional antenna, offering a large command range and a degree of modifiability.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Gladiator.label: Gestate Gladiator
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Gladiator.description: Gestate a gladiator, a ronin derivative highly specialized for melee combat with cold weapons.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Jaeger.label: Gestate Jaeger
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Jaeger.description: Gestate a jaeger, an arquebusier variant specialized for stealth operations.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Mammoth.label: Gestate Tiny Mammoth Automatroid
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Mammoth.description: Gestate a tiny mammoth, a tracked transport platform with medium armor and a general-purpose machine gun.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Phalanx.label: Gestate Phalanx
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Phalanx.description: Gestate a phalanx, a low-cost mass-produced auxiliary variant of the ronin.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Pioneer.label: Gestate Pioneer
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Pioneer.description: Gestate a pioneer, a support unit built to assist snipers.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Protector.label: Gestate Protector
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Protector.description: Gestate a protector, the counter-terrorism variant of the ronin: a special assault model with an integrated ballistic shield, carrying a thick armored shield and a dazzler that briefly blinds enemies in front of it.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Ronin.label: Gestate a Ronin
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Ronin.description: Gestate a ronin, a humanoid mech built for urban warfare. It uses infrasound sonar to find targets in street-fighting environments, and can use it to disrupt the sensory systems of living enemies.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_ShaftWorker.label: Gestate a Shaft Worker Automatroid
LanguageData.DMS_Make_ShaftWorker.description: Gestate a shaft worker, a late-production conversion of the battle frame for logistics construction and excavation work.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Siegebreaker.label: Gestate Siegebreaker
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Siegebreaker.description: Gestate a siegebreaker, a heavily armored mech fitted with rocket engines for short-range assaults.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Sniper.label: Gestate Sniper
LanguageData.DMS_Make_Sniper.description: Gestate a sniper, the long-range sniping specialization of the arquebusier. It can handle heavy sniper cannons, serve as a long-range spotter, or take high-precision shots on its own.
